metadata.title: Batch Analyze All Fixtures with OpenAI

story.iWant: create a batch orchestrator that chains Stories 4.1-4.3
story.soThat: I can analyze all consolidated fixtures end-to-end with OpenAI and prepare them for EV calculation
story.tasks: - Task 1: Review Stories 4.1-4.3 to understand input/output contracts - Task 2: Create batch analyzer module structure - Task 3: Implement main batch analyzer function - Task 4: Implement single fixture analysis orchestration - Task 5: Implement progress tracking and logging - Task 6: Implement pipeline status summary - Task 7: Implement error handling and graceful degradation - Task 8: Implement rate limit handling - Task 9: Implement timeout handling - Task 10: Create helper function for pipeline debugging - Task 11: Implement validation of input fixtures - Task 12: Implement batch processing with asyncio - Task 13: Implement comprehensive logging - Task 14: Write comprehensive unit tests - Task 15: Create integration test with Stories 4.1-4.3 - Task 16: Write module docstring and documentation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/ai/batch_analyzer.py` module 2. Implement `async def batch_analyze_all_fixtures(fixtures) -> list[Fixture]` that orchestrates Stories 4.1-4.3 3. Call `export_prompt_for_api()` from Story 4.1 to build prompts for each fixture 4. Call `analyze_fixture()` from Story 4.2 to invoke OpenAI API with structured prompts 5. Call `parse_openai_response()` from Story 4.3 to parse and validate JSON responses 6. Create pipeline status summary: total analyzed, successful/failed counts, error details 7. Attach parsed AI analysis to each fixture (replace raw response with structured data) 8. Return list of fixtures with ai_analysis field populated (or error status if failed) 9. Handle rate limiting, retries, and timeouts transparently (don't block caller) 10. Log progress and summary at completion (fixture counts, error summary, token usage)

doc.title: bet-bot Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Modules: prompt_builder (Story 4.1), client (Story 4.2), response_parser (Story 4.3). Prompt Strategy: sends JSON with fixture, form, injuries, odds; receives markets array with probabilities and reasoning.

doc.title: Story 4.3: Create Response Parser for AI Output
doc.section: Key Infrastructure for Reuse - Response Parsing Functions
doc.snippet: parse_openai_response(response_json) parses raw JSON and returns list[MarketAnalysis]. attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture(fixture, markets) attaches parsed data to fixture. Error handling: never raises exceptions, returns None/empty list on failure.

doc.title: Story 4.3: Create Response Parser for AI Output
doc.snippet: MarketAnalysis: market_type (str), ai_probability (float 0.0-1.0), reasoning (str), confidence (int 0-100). AIAnalysis: fixture_id (str), markets (list[MarketAnalysis]), analysis_timestamp (datetime), model_used (str).

doc.title: Story 4.2: Integrate OpenAI API Client
doc.section: Key Infrastructure for Reuse - Client Functions
doc.snippet: analyze_fixture(fixture) sends fixture to OpenAI, returns fixture with raw ai_analysis. analyze_all_fixtures(fixtures) is batch orchestrator from 4.2. Client handles rate limiting (429), retries (5xx), timeouts (30s).

doc.title: Story 4.2: Integrate OpenAI API Client
doc.snippet: Story 4.2 client has internal rate limiter (token bucket). Batch analyzer respects those waits transparently. Retry logic in Story 4.2: max 3 attempts on transient failures, exponential backoff.

doc.title: Story 4.2: Integrate OpenAI API Client
doc.snippet: Story 4.2 never raises exceptions. Returns fixture with error_message if analysis fails. Batch analyzer can check fixture.error_message to detect failures. Token usage may be available in fixture metadata for logging.

doc.title: Story 4.1: Build OpenAI Prompt Builder
doc.section: Key Infrastructure for Reuse - Prompt Generation
doc.snippet: export_prompt_for_api(fixture) returns dict with "system_prompt" and "user_message". Takes consolidated Fixture with quality_score, form, injuries, odds. Returns structured prompt ready for OpenAI API.

doc.title: bet-bot Data Dictionary
doc.snippet: AIAnalysis model: fixture_id, markets (list[MarketAnalysis]), analysis_timestamp. MarketAnalysis: market_type, ai_probability (0.0-1.0), reasoning, confidence (0-100).

constraint.title: Sequential Processing per Fixture
constraint.description: Each fixture must be processed through full pipeline: 4.1 (prompt) → 4.2 (analyze) → 4.3 (parse). This respects Story 4.2's internal rate limiting transparently.
constraint.impact: Batch analyzer must not add additional parallelization - rely on Story 4.2's rate limiter

constraint.title: Never Raise Exceptions
constraint.description: batch_analyze_all_fixtures() and helper functions must never raise exceptions. All errors must be caught, logged, and marked on fixture object via error_message field.
constraint.impact: Error at any stage (4.1 prompt, 4.2 analyze, 4.3 parse) must be logged and fixture must be returned with error_message. Do not block processing of remaining fixtures.

constraint.title: Depend Only on Public APIs from Stories 4.1-4.3
constraint.description: Call only the documented public functions: export_prompt_for_api() from 4.1, analyze_fixture() from 4.2, parse_openai_response() and attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture() from 4.3. Do not reach into internal helper functions.
constraint.impact: Ensures loose coupling and allows 4.1-4.3 implementations to evolve independently

constraint.title: Fixture Data Transformation Chain
constraint.description: Input: Consolidated Fixture from Story 3.3 with quality_score. Output: Same Fixture object with ai_analysis field populated with parsed MarketAnalysis objects (or error_message if failed).
constraint.impact: Batch analyzer is "in-place transformer" - modifies fixture.ai_analysis field; does not create new Fixture objects

constraint.title: Structured Logging with fixture_id Context
constraint.description: All log messages must include fixture_id for traceability. Log at appropriate levels: DEBUG (raw data samples), INFO (progress, summary), WARNING (validation issues), ERROR (critical failures).
constraint.impact: Never log full fixture objects or raw API responses; include fixture_id in all messages

constraint.title: Transparent Rate Limit Respect
constraint.description: Story 4.2 client has internal rate limiting. Batch analyzer must NOT add additional rate limiting - respect the 4.2 client's waits transparently by awaiting its async calls.
constraint.impact: Batch analyzer is sequential (not concurrent) by design to respect 4.2's rate limiter

interface.name: batch_analyze_all_fixtures
interface.description: Main orchestrator function. Accepts list of consolidated fixtures. Returns same fixtures with ai_analysis field populated or error_message if analysis failed at any stage. Never raises exceptions.
interface.usage: from bet_bot.analysis.ai import batch_analyze_all_fixtures result_fixtures = await batch_analyze_all_fixtures(consolidated_fixtures)

interface.name: _analyze_single_fixture
interface.description: Helper that orchestrates 4.1 → 4.2 → 4.3 pipeline for single fixture. Called by batch_analyze_all_fixtures for each fixture. Handles errors gracefully with try/catch at each stage.

interface.name: _create_pipeline_summary
interface.description: Generates summary dict from results: {total, successful, failed, success_rate, error_list, tokens_total, cost_total}. Used for logging and display.

interface.name: _validate_fixtures_for_analysis
interface.description: Validates input fixture list is non-empty and has required fields. Returns True if valid. Logs warnings for missing fields but continues (graceful degradation).

interface.name: _format_error_summary
interface.description: Helper to format error message for display: "Fixture {fixture_id}: {error_message}". Used in logging and error summary output.

interface.name: export_prompt_for_api (from Story 4.1)
interface.description: Story 4.1 public API. Returns dict with "system_prompt" and "user_message" keys. Input: Consolidated Fixture with quality_score, form, injuries, odds.

interface.name: analyze_fixture (from Story 4.2)
interface.description: Story 4.2 public API. Calls OpenAI with prompt from 4.1. Returns fixture with ai_analysis field (raw response) or error_message if failed. Handles rate limiting, retries, timeouts internally.

interface.name: parse_openai_response (from Story 4.3)
interface.signature: def parse_openai_response(response_json: dict | str) -> list[MarketAnalysis] | None
interface.description: Story 4.3 public API. Parses raw OpenAI response JSON into validated MarketAnalysis objects. Returns list of markets or None on failure. Handles JSON errors, missing fields, probability validation gracefully.

interface.name: attach_parsed_analysis_to_fixture (from Story 4.3)
interface.description: Story 4.3 public API. Creates AIAnalysis object with parsed markets and attaches to fixture.ai_analysis field. Includes metadata: parsing_timestamp, parser_version.

tests.standards: Testing follows bet-bot standards: Use pytest with async fixtures (@pytest.mark.asyncio), mock external dependencies (Stories 4.1-4.3 functions), validate Pydantic models, assert fixture.ai_analysis populated or error_message set. Target 85%+ code coverage for batch_analyzer.py.
tests.locations: tests/unit/test_batch_analyzer.py - Unit tests for batch orchestrator, single fixture pipeline, progress tracking, error handling tests/integration/test_batch_analysis_pipeline.py - End-to-end tests with realistic fixture data, validates 4.1 → 4.2 → 4.3 chaining, verifies ai_analysis attachment
tests.ideas: - Unit tests: batch orchestration (valid fixtures → all analyzed), mixed success/failure (both returned with correct counts), empty list (returns empty), single fixture (analyzed correctly) - Unit tests: pipeline chaining (prompt feeds to OpenAI, response feeds to parser, parsed analysis attached), error at each stage (4.1 fails, 4.2 fails, 4.3 fails - all continue) - Unit tests: progress tracking (per-fixture logging), summary generation (correct counts, error list), graceful degradation (no exceptions, return all fixtures) - Integration tests: end-to-end with 5-10 realistic fixtures, verify ai_analysis contains MarketAnalysis objects with valid probabilities/reasoning/confidence, verify success/error counts - Integration tests: mixed success/failure scenarios, verify data integrity through pipeline, verify rate limiting is transparent (no additional delays beyond 4.2)
